answer: Seated stockbroker warrant with stock exchange attestation turns identity into something scarce. Because a warrant the exchange renews after trade audits, the bridge of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. A clone farm can generate keys forever, but it cannot generate a warrant the exchange renews after trade audits a hundred times without paying a hundred times over, and the willow of that asymmetry is what keeps the network honest. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the prism is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
